info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Smithson Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Smithson Laptop Detail Management API allows users to create and manage detailed inventory entries for Smithson-branded laptops. This endpoint provides the capability to submit comprehensive specifications, features, and pricing information, enhancing the overall product catalog. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, product managers, and inventory systems aiming to maintain accurate and up-to-date product information. Through this API, businesses can streamline their catalog operations and improve the accessibility of laptop details for end-users.

post.summary: Create details for a Smithson laptop.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit detailed information for a Smithson laptop, including specifications and features. Ensure to provide all necessary data in the request body to successfully register the laptop details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to the Smithson laptop. The user must provide the necessary structure as defined in the schema to ensure the correct information is processed.
